project: Medhā Nādopāsanā – Music Builder & Guided Manodharma
module: Phase 1: Swara Palette & Dynamic Rāga Grammar Engine
description: Defines active/locked swara palettes across 3 octaves, 22-sruti harmonic linking, and dynamic raga grammar validation rules for all 72 Melakartas and key Janyas.

octave_definitions.name: Madhya Sthāyi (Middle / Natural Speaking Register)
octave_definitions.display_symbol_prefix: S R G M P D N

validation_states.label: Valid Note
validation_states.description: Swara adheres to the raga scales and prayoga rules.

validation_states.label: Vivadi Swara Note
validation_states.description: Note is valid but requires careful intonation and vocal placement.

validation_states.label: Bhashanga Anya Swara
validation_states.description: Foreign note valid only within specific canonical phrases.

validation_states.label: Varjya Violation
validation_states.description: Note is omitted in this raga or in this direction.

validation_states.label: Vakra Grammar Violation
validation_states.description: Note sequence violates the non-linear zig-zag rule of this raga.

palette_keys.name: Kaisiki Nishadam
palette_keys.lock_reason: Anya Swara: permitted exclusively in phrase P D2 N2 D2 P

bhashanga_rules.rule: Kaisiki Nishada (N2) is permitted only in descending curve P D2 N2 D2 P; elsewhere only Kakali N3 is valid.

keys_palette.name: Kaisiki Nishadam

janya_palettes.name: Ānandabhairavi

palette_keys.name: Antara Gandharam
palette_keys.lock_reason: Anya Swara: permitted exclusively in phrase P M1 G3 M1 P

vakra_rules.pattern: S G2 R2 G2 M1 P D2 P Ṡ
vakra_rules.rule: Ascent must loop R2 between G2; cannot move linear S R G M.
Dhaivata is flanked by Panchama before reaching Tara Shadja.

bhashanga_rules.rule: Occasional prayoga in specific classical compositions.

bhashanga_rules.allowed_phrase: S R2 G2 M1 P D2 N3 Ṡ

keys_palette.name: Antara Gandharam

janya_palettes.avarohana: Ṡ N2 D1 M1 G2 M1 P M1 G2 R2 S

vakra_rules.pattern: S G2 R2 G2 M1 N2 N2 Ṡ
vakra_rules.rule: Twin Nishada leap N2 N2 Ṡ required to reach Tara Shadja.

vakra_rules.pattern: Ṡ N2 D1 M1 G2 M1 P M1 G2 R2 S
vakra_rules.rule: Descent must weave around Madhyama (P M1 G2 R2 S).
